conditions.name: App error rate
conditions.description: Real error log lines from container ai-listings per minute, excluding auth proxy diagnostics, sustained for 10 minutes.
conditions.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE namespace_name = 'ai-listings' AND container_name = 'ai-listings' AND message RLIKE '(?i).*(error|exception|fail|fatal).*' AND message NOT LIKE '%"event":"proxy_check"%' AND message NOT LIKE '%"event":"proxy_redirect_to_login"%'
conditions.historyQuery: SELECT earliest(timestamp) FROM Log WHERE namespace_name = 'ai-listings' AND container_name = 'ai-listings' SINCE 8 days ago

conditions.name: Log silence
conditions.description: No log lines from container ai-listings for 10 minutes (app down or log shipping broken).
conditions.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE namespace_name = 'ai-listings' AND container_name = 'ai-listings'
conditions.historyQuery: SELECT earliest(timestamp) FROM Log WHERE namespace_name = 'ai-listings' AND container_name = 'ai-listings' SINCE 8 days ago

conditions.name: APM error rate
conditions.description: Count of failed transactions per 5 minute window, sustained for 10 minutes. An absolute count fires at low traffic, where a percentage with a request minimum almost never has two qualifying windows.
conditions.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'ai-listings' AND error IS true
conditions.historyQuery: SELECT earliest(timestamp) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'ai-listings' SINCE 8 days ago

conditions.name: APM p95 latency
conditions.description: p95 transaction duration in seconds over 5 minute windows, sustained for 10 minutes, with a 3 request minimum. Placeholder threshold, set from 7 days of history before enabling.
conditions.nrql: SELECT if(count(*) >= 3, percentile(duration, 95), null) AS 'p95' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'ai-listings'
conditions.historyQuery: SELECT earliest(timestamp) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'ai-listings' SINCE 8 days ago

conditions.name: Inngest queue depth
conditions.description: Inngest queue depth stays above the threshold for 15 minutes (queue not draining). Placeholder threshold, set from 7 days of history before enabling.
conditions.historyQuery: SELECT earliest(timestamp) FROM Metric WHERE metricName = 'inngest_queue_depth' SINCE 8 days ago

conditions.name: Inngest function failures
conditions.description: At least one Inngest function run ends with a status other than completed within a single 15 minute window, so bursty failures fire. Placeholder rule, tune from 7 days of history before enabling.
conditions.nrql: SELECT sum(inngest_function_run_ended_total) FROM Metric WHERE status != 'completed'
conditions.historyQuery: SELECT earliest(timestamp) FROM Metric WHERE metricName = 'inngest_function_run_ended_total' SINCE 8 days ago
